content.Title: 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Heart Failure Guideline
content.Purpose: The guideline discusses management and treatment strategies for heart failure based on evidence and expert recommendations.
Sections: Classification of HF by Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction (LVEF)
Key Points: Discussion of evidence-based guidelines for heart failure stages and management.
Assessment and classification of heart failure with preserved and reduced ejection fraction.
Prevalence and diagnostic criteria for different heart failure stages.
Recommendations on pharmacological treatment and heart failure diagnostics.
